behavior.batch_growth: Measured batches begin at one operation, double to the configured cap, then continue at the cap. No calibration or warmup.
behavior.stability: Adjacent-batch residual against least-squares per-operation estimate; default relative deviation 0.05 after 100ms. For ratio 2 this is Criterion formula. Equal-sized capped batches use ratio 1.
behavior.deadlines: Default wall limit 5s; cooperative checks after each completed call. Sampling maximum budget checked first; stability also requires sampling minimum budget.
behavior.samples: Every actual completed batch retained; slow first batch stays a single sample instead of synthetic duplication. Iteration and sample caps prevent unbounded growth.
behavior.configuration: Suite fallback, case attributes, inline/imported groups and direct Cargo CLI. CLI overrides case choices. Explicit false disables inheritance.
behavior.reports: Actual sample counts and stop reason recorded; repeated runs reset schedule and remove stale quick metadata.

evidence: bench/scripts/test-cargo-bench.py (quick CLI, attributes, dry-run, conflicts and test precedence)
